overviewHtml:
Setting up access for each new team in Account Management means repeating the same clicks for groups, policies and environments.

What you get

  • Group creation through the Account Management API
  • Default policies such as AppEngine - User and Hub Catalog Read
  • Parameterized policies limiting read access to a management zone, security context or host group
  • Bindings in both a non-production and a production environment
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • Account Management access to create an OAuth client with permission to manage groups and policies
  • The custom parameterized policy above, created in your account
  • api.dynatrace.com and sso.dynatrace.com in the allowed outbound connections
setupHtml:
1. Create the OAuth client.
  2. Store the client secret in the credential vault of the environment where the workflow will run.
  3. Download iam-group-management.workflow-template.yaml and upload it in Workflows.
  4. In the groups_definition task, replace `` with your group details.
  5. In the env_var task, replace `` with your account ID, client ID, the credential vault ID of the secret, and the other required fields.
  6. Run the workflow.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows and an OAuth client with permission to manage groups and policies.

  1. Create the OAuth client and store its secret in the credential vault
  2. Upload the workflow template in Workflows
  3. Fill in your group and account details
  4. Run the workflow
